'''''Rodian Collector''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The Rodian was encircled in the middle of the painting and was shown collecting artifacts of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], namely a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. Around the outside of the encircled Rodian were depictions of a [[Holochess/Legends|holochess]] [[Hologame table/Legends|game table]], a [[Fish/Legends|fish]] caught on a [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] line, and the Rodian from the painting's center doing battle with a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]&mdash;a vicious beast native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Rodian Collector'' was a painting available to players in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], and was added to the game with the ''Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes'' update. It could be obtained by the player after finishing a small quest chain meant to familiarize them with the newly added "Collections" system, which allowed players to collect various sets of loot or interactive world objects, which would yield a reward when the entire set was collected. The painting could only be obtained during the release of Chapter 7, and was no longer available with the release of ''Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis''.<ref name="SWG" />
